summary: The filing is an 8-K by TPG Private Equity Opportunities, L.P. reporting unregistered sales of limited partnership units in its continuous private offering, totaling $82.6 million in August 2026, plus a description of its transactional NAV methodology. This is a routine periodic disclosure of private placement activity and valuation policy, not a transformative special situation such as an acquisition, spin-off, or restructuring. No strategic event, tender offer, or board-level change is involved; it is an ordinary operational filing for a closed-end fund.
